scripts.studio: npm run sync-public && remotion studio source/index.jsx --public-dir=public --browser-executable="C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"
scripts.render: npm run sync-public && remotion render source/index.jsx MAHVARA-Portfolio renders/MAHVARA-Portfolio-Final.mp4 --public-dir=public --browser-executable="C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --concurrency=50%
